objections.claim: The whole-tree seccomp mechanism is internally unsatisfiable: it denies AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket() creation while asserting outbound connect() still works. TCP/TLS clients such as gh and networked git must first create an AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket, so required API and attestation operations will fail before connect(). Denying bind/listen/accept can enforce the listener prohibition, but denying client socket creation contradicts the required executable closure and leaves doctor/verify --full inoperable.

The substituted off-main workflow defense does not prevent release mutation. The candidate explicitly permits an off-main workflow_dispatch definition to run and acknowledges that a workflow can elevate GITHUB_TOKEN from the read-only repository default by requesting contents:write. Environment branch policies gate environment secrets, not GITHUB_TOKEN permissions; main/tag rulesets prevent ref mutation but do not prevent contents:write from editing or deleting existing drafts/releases. This also contradicts the plan's own statement that contents:write can delete an immutable release. Therefore the SUBSTITUTED-DEFINITION regression can mutate trusted release state despite all stated controls, and the claim that substituted workflow bytes can reach nothing privileged is false.
